plan: For capital preservation, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% and CRWD to 10% to reduce concentration and meet mandate limits.
Reduce SMH to 5% as it is flagged for trimming.
Increase QQQI to 25% to favor income and broad index exposure.
Buy GDX at 5% as a top-quality long setup to diversify.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect modest growth with reduced volatility.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to 1% each to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Reduce SPY to 25% and CRWD to 10% to manage concentration and meet mandate.
Trim SMH to 8% as it is flagged for trimming.
Buy GDX at 4% and HOOD at 3% to add strong long setups.
This plan balances growth with risk management, maintaining a small cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index with quality tech. Expect moderate growth with managed drawdowns.

plan: Trim SPY to 25%, CRWD to 10%, and SMH to 10% to meet mandate and manage flagged holdings.
Add to SOXL and SPAL, targeting 6% each, to increase leveraged exposure.
Buy GDX at 6% and HOOD at 5% to concentrate in high-scoring scanner setups.
This plan uses leverage and concentration for stretch growth, with strict stops.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs decay daily.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero to prioritize income and stability.
Trim SPY to 20%, CRWD to 5%, and SMH to 5% to reduce high-beta exposure and meet mandates.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to maximize income and monthly distributions.
Increase QQQ to 25% for broad index exposure and stability.
This plan focuses on parking cash for yield with low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions. It cuts leverage and high-beta names to near zero, focusing on income and broad index ETFs. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in selloffs.
